views.title: Cyberwarfare R&D for OT and cyber-physical systems — IKELOS Group
views.description: IKELOS Group supports the warfighter and protects critical civilian operations through Exquisite Access Development, Systems Behavior Validation and Survivability Testing, and Cyber Effects Development and Validation.

views.title: Three research practices — IKELOS Group
views.description: Three specializations in operational technology and complex cyber-physical systems: access development, systems survivability testing, and cyber effects validation.

views.title: Exquisite Access Development — IKELOS Group
views.description: Authorized research into unfamiliar OT and cyber-physical systems. Scope access feasibility, foreign materiel exploitation, controlled demonstrations, and evidence.

views.title: Systems Behavior Validation and Survivability Testing — IKELOS Group
views.description: Test critical functions, degraded operation, and recovery under defined conditions in operational technology and complex cyber-physical systems.

views.title: Cyber Effects Development and Validation — IKELOS Group
views.description: Develop and measure a specified cyber effect in an authorized laboratory. Explicit prerequisites, controlled demonstrations, and bounded evidence.

views.title: For prime partners and government — IKELOS Group
views.description: Scope specialist OT and cyber-physical research for prime contractor partnerships and government evaluation: technical fit, evidence, milestones, and acquisition requirements.

views.title: Research foundations — IKELOS Group
views.description: PHOBETOR and VEILTRACE research foundations: embedded implementation, controlled environments, demonstrated basis, and proposed development.

views.title: PHOBETOR — IKELOS Group
views.description: Full-system emulation and vulnerability discovery research direction, building on a bounded embedded Linux workflow. Explicit maturity and target-specific engineering requirements.

views.title: VEILTRACE — IKELOS Group
views.description: Threat-representative test environment research. Initial Ludus configuration feasibility, proposed hybrid OT and scale research, and explicit model limits.
